summary: Full E2E (backend + frontend) verification of Iter14 Regime-Lab enhancements. Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_regime_lab_history_and_shadow.py: 18/18 passed. Verified: GET /api/regime-lab/calibrations returns unified history containing seed autopilot row aptest001 (source='autopilot', report.metric='holdout_direction_pct', report.holdout_regressed=true, report.best_config populated) alongside scientific rows (source='calibration', metric='balanced_direction_pct'); ?include_autopilot=false hides autopilot rows. POST /api/regime-lab/engine/snapshots requires admin (401/403 without token), rejects missing engine_config (400), and creates snapshot returned as first item in GET list. POST /api/regime-lab/shadow/backfill requires admin and returns {scanned, labeled, skipped_no_release, symbols} (all zero on empty DB). POST /api/regime-lab/{aid}/rename admin-guarded, validates empty name (400), unknown aid (404), and roundtrip (name reflected in GET /list). GET /api/regime-lab/ra_ca0b956f exposes analysis.symbols_requested=['BTCUSDT','CLUSDT'] and symbols_skipped.CLUSDT.reason. Regression: /list, /active, /engine/defaults, /autopilot/runs, /releases all 200; DELETE /regime-lab/unknown -> 404. Frontend (Playwright, viewport 1920x1080): admin login via admin-lock-button + admin-login-modal succeeds. Regime-Lab opened via tools-menu-button -> tools-menu-regime-lab. History toggle expands 5 rows; aptest001 row shows badge 'Autopilot', text 'Holdout Live=Final 96.4% → 95.7%', '⚠ Holdout gefallen'; scientific rows show 'Wissenschaftlich' and 'Treffer (Referenz)'. regime-engine-snapshots section renders 3 snapshot rows with restore buttons. autopilot-section contains 'nie ein schlechteres Ergebnis'. Selecting analysis ra_ca0b956f shows disabled regime-scope-tab-missing-coin:CLUSDT ('CL · kein Modell') plus regime-scope-missing-note ('⚠ Ohne Einzel-Modell: CL (zu wenig Daten: 80 Kerzen (1h), mind. 101 nötig)'); BTC missing-coin button correctly absent. As admin: clicking regime-calibration-apply-aptest001 activated the autopilot calibration – regime-calibrate-active now reads '✓ Kalibrierung aktiv · Holdout Live=Final 96.4% → 95.7% · via Kalibrierungs-Verlauf (Autopilot)', regime-calibration-active-aptest001 marker present, header regime-summary-calibration-active shows 'aktiv · Holdout Live=Final 96.4% → 95.7%' (metric label instead of bare 'Treffer'). Snapshot restore of newest snap_ff123fa011 succeeded (toast text 'wiederhergestellt' visible on page). Rename via regime-analysis-rename-ra_ca0b956f -> input -> save persisted 'TEST_iter14_ui_rename' in the row; name reset back to 'Test · BTC + Öl (Öl ohne Daten)'. Delete button regime-analysis-delete-ra_b62d7dcf triggered window.confirm with message 'Regime-Analyse „Regime-Analyse 1h · 120d“ wirklich löschen? Modell, Nachweise, Zuordnungen und Walk-Forward-Ergebnis werden dauerhaft entfernt – das kann NICHT rückgängig gemacht werden.'; dismissal preserved the row (no deletion performed). dyn-panel-toggle opens the Dynamic Strategies section; no dyn-delete-* entries currently exist so the conditional confirm branch was not exercised (matches 'falls Einträge existieren').

integration_issues.flow: Autopilot apply from history creates snapshot
integration_issues.issue: Snapshot count did not increase after clicking regime-calibration-apply-aptest001 (before=3, after=3). Restore of the returned newest snapshot still works, and manual POST /api/regime-lab/engine/snapshots produces a new row correctly, so the pre-existing snapshot from the seed/prior apply is likely being reused (or apply is not calling POST). Spec says: 'vor jeder Übernahme wird der alte Stand als Snapshot gesichert'. Please verify RegimeCalibrationHistory.applyRow saves a snapshot before applying (or that de-dupe by hash is intentional).

action_items: Optional: confirm/apply flow explicitly persists a pre-apply engine snapshot (see integration issue above) – functional impact is small because snapshots list already contains restore-able entries.
critical_code_review_comments: rename_analysis correctly enforces admin, name length (1-120) and 404 on unknown aid.

list_calibrations merges scientific + autopilot rows without leaking Mongo _id; row shape (source/report.metric/report.best_config/holdout_regressed) matches what RegimeCalibrationHistory.js consumes.

Frontend AnalysisDetail renders regime-scope-tab-missing-coin:<sym> as a disabled button with reason note, correctly gated by symbols_skipped metadata from the analysis document.
window.confirm is used consistently for destructive actions (regime analysis delete, dynamic strategy delete) with clear German copy.
